references.text: The Lord spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks with his friend. This confirms the unique relationship between God and Moses described in Deuteronomy 34:10.
God declares that He speaks with Moses face to face, not in riddles, and that Moses sees the form of the Lord. This underscores Moses' unique prophetic position.
Moses prophesies about a future prophet like himself whom the Lord will raise up. This points forward to one who will have the same closeness to God as Moses had.
Moses' first encounter with God at the burning bush, where God reveals Himself and calls Moses to service.
The book of Hebrews compares Jesus with Moses and declares that Jesus is worthy of greater honor than Moses, just as the builder of a house has more honor than the house itself.
